item.title: WTKR Features KIBC Beach Toy Recycling Program – Keep It Beachy Clean
item.description: Now at the Virginia Beach Oceanfront—Beach Toy Recycling! News 3 WTKR recently featured our Beach Toy Recycling Program, highlighting how families can help reduce plastic waste by donating or picking up gently used beach toys. Thanks to John Hood for helping us spread the word and keep our coast clean!
